hints: Notice the four wavelengths $10^{-2}\text{ m}$, $10^{-5}\text{ m}$, $10^{-10}\text{ m}$ and $10^{-13}\text{ m}$ decrease from left to right, so the correct row must run from longer-wave to shorter-wave regions.
Recall the wavelength order: radio waves, microwaves, infra-red, visible light near $10^{-7}\text{ m}$, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma rays.
Check the extremes: $10^{-2}\text{ m}$ is $1\text{ cm}$ on the microwave side of the radio boundary, and $10^{-13}\text{ m}$ is shorter than typical $10^{-10}\text{ m}$ X-rays.
walkthrough: List the given wavelengths in order: $10^{-2}\text{ m} > 10^{-5}\text{ m} > 10^{-10}\text{ m} > 10^{-13}\text{ m}$, so wavelength decreases and frequency increases to the right.

Use the electromagnetic spectrum order of decreasing wavelength: radio waves, microwaves, infra-red, visible light at about $4 \times 10^{-7}\text{ m}$ to $7 \times 10^{-7}\text{ m}$, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma rays.

Assign the anchors: $10^{-2}\text{ m} = 1\text{ cm}$ fits centimetre microwaves; $10^{-5}\text{ m} = 10\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ is longer than visible light so fits infra-red; $10^{-10}\text{ m} = 0.1\text{ nm}$ fits X-rays; $10^{-13}\text{ m}$ is still shorter so fits gamma rays.
Only the row microwaves, infra-red, X-rays, gamma rays matches all four positions. This is option B.

A.explanation: It reverses the first two regions because $10^{-2}\text{ m}$ is longer wavelength than $10^{-5}\text{ m}$, so $10^{-2}\text{ m}$ cannot be infra-red while $10^{-5}\text{ m}$ is microwaves. It also puts visible light at $10^{-10}\text{ m}$, far shorter than about $10^{-7}\text{ m}$.

B.explanation: $10^{-2}\text{ m}$ is a centimetre-scale microwave, $10^{-5}\text{ m}$ is infra-red, $10^{-10}\text{ m}$ is X-ray wavelength and $10^{-13}\text{ m}$ is even shorter gamma-ray wavelength.

C.explanation: Visible light is centred near $10^{-7}\text{ m}$, not $10^{-5}\text{ m}$, and ultraviolet is near $10^{-8}\text{ m}$ to $10^{-7}\text{ m}$, not $10^{-10}\text{ m}$.

D.explanation: Radio waves are generally longer than about $10^{-1}\text{ m}$, so $10^{-2}\text{ m}$ is too short, and $10^{-5}\text{ m}$ is infra-red rather than microwaves.
